nights.title: Alyssa Grace
nights.name: Alyssa Grace
nights.extract: Alyssa Grace Proffitt is an American singer-songwriter based in California. She made her recording debut in 2026 with "Dog with a Bone" and gained wider recognition through the singles "Picking Petals" and "Bloodstream".

en.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt is an American singer-songwriter based in California. She gained wider recognition through the singles Picking Petals and Bloodstream.
facts: She made her recording debut in 2026 with Dog with a Bone.
Picking Petals and Bloodstream brought her wider recognition.

de.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt ist eine amerikanische Singer-Songwriterin mit Wohnsitz in Kalifornien. Größere Bekanntheit erlangte sie durch die Singles Picking Petals und Bloodstream.
facts: Ihr Aufnahmedebüt gab sie 2026 mit Dog with a Bone.
Picking Petals und Bloodstream brachten ihr größere Bekanntheit.

tr.who: Alyssa Grace Proffitt, Kaliforniya merkezli Amerikalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Picking Petals ve Bloodstream single'larıyla daha geniş bir kitleye ulaştı.
facts: Kayıt kariyerine 2026'da Dog with a Bone ile başladı.
Picking Petals ve Bloodstream ona daha geniş bir tanınırlık kazandırdı.
